profile.name: CJ Presley
profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Citizens Advice SORT
profile.bio: I build digital tools with TypeScript, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI. Day to day I work with developers and non-developers at Citizens Advice SORT. Outside work I study software engineering, make art, and write.

experience.summary: Part of a team building and shipping digital solutions with TypeScript, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI, through AWS and GCP with a focus on AI solutions to supporting charity work.

achievements.text: Helped lay the foundations SCPs (Simulated Client Personas) in a new agentic training platform, having a basis in voice to text transcription and evaluation.
Helped to build a platform with the pupose of supporting clients in their PIP journey, tool aimed to be a gateway to an appointment and is projected to reduce appointment times by 60%.

Handled design, development and architecture documentation for the various projects that the team worked on, laying the groundwork for further development as well as championing the usage of the GitHub project boards as a means to manage tasks and issues.
Attended shareholder meetings to converse and network with funders regarding the future of the fund and the direction of the project using the funding they awarded us.
Championed the necessity of a rebuild to the internal expenses app and led the development of the new app using React and Node.js with a python backend and Firebase database.
Created the initial accessibility feature for two of the training platforms whilst pushing to be allowed to implement such features across the entire catalogue of products we build/work on.
